title: The Game of Life: DX Jinsei Game
overview:
Life has its ups and downs... Life is fun because so much happens.

DX Jinsei Game brings Takara's Japanese version of The Game of Life to the Saturn as a video board game for one to four players. Spin the roulette wheel to drive your car along the board, starting out as a high school student with 10 million yen, and see what life throws at you along the way.

Each player has stats for intelligence, stamina and sense, and a job and rank that change as the game goes on. Squares can bring good luck or sudden disaster, and special events can turn the standings upside down - one even cuts everyone's cash down to match the poorest player. An angel and a little devil watch over the board.

- 1 to 4 players, with multitap support
- Save your game to backup memory

人生、山あり谷あり…。人生はいろいろあるから面白い。
